entity.name: Fady Mondy
entity.description: Independent open-source maintainer in Egypt. Creator of ToGO (an API-first Go + React full-stack framework with 4 open-source production apps and 240 plugin repos) and TomatoPHP (164 FilamentPHP/Laravel packages, ~1.79M installs).

projects.name: ToGO
projects.description: API-first full-stack framework for Go (sqlc + Atlas + React) with an artisan-style CLI, an MCP server and 240 open-source plugins (auth, payments, AI, deploy, storage). Zekra, Mahaam, Moharrik and Hosbah are built on it.

projects.name: TomatoPHP
projects.description: MIT plugin ecosystem for Laravel and FilamentPHP: users, CMS, media manager, invoices, e-commerce, PWA, translations, developer tools. 164 Packagist packages, ~1.79M installs.

projects.name: Zekra
projects.description: Self-hostable shared long-term memory for AI agents over the Model Context Protocol.
